people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Son of Abraham and Hagar; father of Arab tribes.

translations.web: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”
translations.bsb: And Abraham said to God, “O that Ishmael might live under Your blessing!”
